skills.description:
Quantify Western blot / 1-D gel band intensity from a blot image, headless,
with math identical to ImageJ's Measure command. Handles three layouts:
one band per lane, multiple bands per lane (e.g. 1+2+1+2), and stacked
multi-frame co-IP figures (IP: anti-flag on top, IB: anti-actin below).
Reports Mean / IntDen / Area / Min / Max / background and
NetIntDen = bgMean*Area - IntDen per band, normalizes to a reference lane,
and can also compute the loading volume per lane needed to equalize the
reference (actin) band.

Use this skill when the user wants band grayscale / intensity / optical
density quantification, WB densitometry, relative protein expression from a
blot, loading-control normalization, or asks "measure the bands", "灰度值",
"条带定量", "内参归一化", "上样量怎么调", with a blot image attached.

Triggers: Western blot quantification, WB densitometry, band intensity,
grayscale measurement, ImageJ Measure equivalent, loading control
normalization, actin normalization, co-IP blot quantification,
gel band optical density, 条带灰度, 灰度值测定, 内参归一化, 上样量归一化.

Self-verifiable: `scripts/make_test_image.py --verify` builds a synthetic
blot with known ratios and checks the pipeline recovers them.
skills.description_zh: Western blot 条带灰度定量，无需 ImageJ 即可离线运行，算法与 ImageJ Measure 命令逐项等价。支持单带、单泳道双带（1+2+1+2）、以及堆叠双框 co-IP 图（上目的 / 下内参）。输出每条带的 Mean、IntDen、Area、背景灰度与净强度 NetIntDen = bgMean x Area - IntDen，并按参考泳道归一化；另可计算各泳道为配平内参所需的上样体积。内置合成测试图生成器，可用已知比值自检验证安装。
skills.name: WB 条带灰度定量

skills.description_zh:
马维斯化自 https://github.com/XBuilderLAB/cheat-on-content（MIT 许可，XBuilderLAB 官方）。
Cheat on Content 面向内容创作者，把每条作品变成一次可校准实验：先打分、盲预测，发布后
T+3d 复盘，再根据数据进化评分公式（rubric）。方法论通用，适用于视频 / 文章 / 播客 /
Newsletter / 短文 thread 等任何可被量化（播放 / 阅读 / 收听 / 点击）的内容形态；当前内置
一份观点视频 rubric（参考博主 25+ 视频拟合），其他形态可借 starter-rubrics 起步并 bump 调权重。

核心闭环（5 阶段）：打分(score) → 盲预测(blind-predict) → 发布(publish) → T+3d 复盘(retro)
→ 进化 rubric(bump)。含 15 个子技能（cheat-init 入口、cheat-learn-from 对标导入、
cheat-seed 选题、cheat-score / cheat-score-blind 打分、cheat-predict 盲预测、
cheat-shoot / cheat-publish 拍摄与发布登记、cheat-retro 复盘、cheat-persona 受众画像、
cheat-bump rubric 升级、cheat-recommend 选题推荐、cheat-trends 热点抓取、
cheat-status 看板、cheat-migrate 迁移）。三条不可妥协原则：① 盲预测必须写在看到任何实际
数据之前，写完 immutable；② rubric 升级须全量重打校准池并经跨模型独立审核；③ rubric 是
工作台不是博物馆，被数据推翻的观察即删。GitHub 官方安装：git clone 后 bash install.sh
（支持 Claude Code / --codex / --all）。触发词："初始化"/"打分这篇"/"启动预测"/"已发布"/
"复盘"/"升级 rubric"/"推荐选题"/"抓热点"/"状态"/"找对标"。首次使用必须先跑 cheat-init。
skills.name: 内容创作校准器
